rules.statement: Mitch and Scorpion stayed at camp to repair the generators. They offered Panam equipment for recovering her vehicle and cargo.
V and Panam recovered her vehicle and delivered the recovered cargo at Sunset Motel.
Panam and V brought down the corporate AV carrying Hellman.
V helped Panam resolve the hostage situation at the AV wreck and free Mitch.
The AV pilot told V, Panam and Mitch that Hellman had been taken west to the gas station.
Panam briefed V on the Wraiths holding Saul and the plan to extract him from their base.
The escape with Saul drew pursuit, and V defended the getaway vehicle.
V, Panam and Saul escaped the Wraiths without the vehicle chase.
The attempt to rescue Saul ended in failure; Panam sent V a failure message.
V helped Panam and the veterans secure the Basilisk convoy.
The team brought the old railway locomotive online for the convoy operation.
At the railway tower V told Panam that this help was not free, and Panam responded about a firearm reward.
V and Panam operated the Basilisk and completed its target practice.
Panam and V helped defend the Aldecaldos camp against the Raffen with the Basilisk.
Panam knew that V had passed out and that the Aldecaldos brought V to the new camp.
Panam learned that Scorpion and other nomads died at the AV wreck, while Mitch survived.
With Panam helping the pursuit, V captured Hellman at the gas station.
